# PR #180 correctness verdict

**PASS-WITH-NOTES** at `0ffb88381f6ea11ed6d8816affe2b20b238d7621`.

Reviewed the frozen source and exact-head CI. The checkout is clean/detached, matches the remote pin, and GitHub reports CLEAN.

## Reinjection safety and lease behavior

canRetryDiscarded now reads a validated queue snapshot first. A matching queued item/steer or an in-flight steer returns false; a processing run also returns false. Neither answer authorizes an acknowledgement or resend, so uncertainty need not fail those waiting paths.

The possible-resend branch still drains fresh history and probes the independent tail before deciding non-consumption. discardUncertain is sticky for that completion. When consumption remains unseen and uncertainty is set, waitOutUncertainDiscard only returns false or throws at the escalation ceiling; it never authorizes journal rearm or native.send. The change introduces no new true result for an uncertain completion.

Consumption is correlated to the bound native ID, not any user event or subagent activity. The existing delivery path rechecks consumption before rearm and after its asynchronous journal operation. Accepted journal replay scans history from an undefined cursor, rather than beginning after earlier consumption. Malformed/unsupported snapshots and ambiguous durable send intents remain hard failures, not resend permission.

The uncertain empty-queue/idle case uses the existing 250 ms-to-5 s observation backoff, emits discard-uncertain once per completion, and holds after 600000 ms of that uncertainty episode. Late correlated consumption settles and acknowledges the original job without a second send.

Hard hold does not keep the renewal loop running: holdReceiving aborts receiverController and heartbeatController; the receiver loop's finally also aborts both. Heartbeats carry the heartbeat abort signal and the loop checks it before another cycle. This stops future renewals, not an already-admitted server write or the existing lease instantaneously; expiry still follows the daemon's finite TTL.

## Exact-head tests and mutation grades

CI [42449058166](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42449058166) passed all jobs. The Node 24 log explicitly passes the three F124 cases: the exact 12:31 one-event-gap/queued-steer replay, late consumption from empty/idle uncertainty, and escalation at HOLD_ESCALATION_MS. Assertions cover one original send, no journal rearm, heartbeat renewal while waiting, no early hold and correct eventual acknowledgement/hold.

The same log passes existing stale-cursor, inaccessible-gap, subagent-spoof, late-proof and native-RPC deadline controls. Its main native suite reports 333 passed/zero failed. Rust JUnit artifact 13604603836 has **2202 cases, zero failures/errors**, including receiver expiry/transport and the PA lapsed-receiver test.

The author reports two executed mutations on the pre-commit tree identical for store.mjs/progress.test.mjs: restoring uncertainty-first fails all three F124 cases; immediate uncertain hold fails both waiting cases. These are author-executed witnesses, not reviewer-local reruns.

**N001, proof ceiling:** kestrel explicitly confirmed no executed mutant for bypassing the uncertain no-resend veto, and no F124 assertion that ticks heartbeats AFTER hard hold. The empty/idle tests assert no resend/rearm, but their first failure under a removed veto would be the missing once-only diagnostic; do not represent that mutant as independently executed behavioral proof. The production stop code is unchanged and correct by source inspection; a future heartbeat-stop witness should test the contract despite the redundant finally abort, not claim a single removed abort line must fail.

## PA diagnostic, transport and resource scope

The native lease refusal now publishes extension-stream, preserving its outcome through the existing event helper. The Rust regression checks the outcome's transport.

The PA digest and refusal use the same receiver_live predicate: current-incarnation identity match and renewal age, or the fixed daemon-start grace when no lease exists. Mismatched incarnation does not borrow another lease; host activity never extends the grace. The paused-time real-store test positively includes never-renewed and stopped-renewing native seats, excludes renewing/non-native seats, and checks the anomaly count. Tombstoned seats are excluded by source. These are consistent predicates; a subsequent renewal can naturally change a later snapshot.

No new production launch or timer. Uncertain waiting reuses one completion's existing SDK-read/backoff loop, with no process spawn; the digest adds one in-memory lease-map lock and a pass over its existing fleet rows. The original incident timeline and mutation runs are delivery-owned evidence. No private session dump, local Cargo/Node test, live native probe, dependency change or product edit was performed by this reviewer.
